physical_or_evidence_reason.request: N_MATCH 143.0-183.5 degC in TC1-TC4 of P7 v2 against the 60 degC ceiling, failing at P_fwd = 0 W and at every R_HALL grid point, heated by conduction (0.5 W/K) from the ICP bracket at 179-211 degC (docs/closure/thermal/thermal_closure_v2.json sha256 06b26333b265a706e0c9bfcdbee1567fe800dbd19b3a05d9f4922ef85eb9dc4d; request docs/closure/thermal/dcr_request_P7_match_v1.json sha256 d1205b3b28d783d94339f321220b0b899bace20690dcc076b04b4bd13f27407a)
physical_or_evidence_reason.finding: the failure is a mounting / heat-rejection deficiency of the match installation, not a location constraint: with the bracket conductance reduced to the isolator range and a 0.15 m^2 dedicated radiator, N_MATCH is 54.4 degC at the worst governing hot case (TC4, HOT corner incl. the RF lead from the 592 degC antenna and the lead RF loss), margin 5.6 K beyond the 50 K rule; relocating the match instead puts a VSWR 60-1900 line between match and antenna (antenna X_A ~ 164 Ohm against R_A 0.5-5 Ohm), whose loss needs P_fwd 214-9044 W for the 200 W anchor delivery (reference corner 878 W, outside the 500 W DBF1-RF-02 envelope)
